title: 10Sept-Ganapati Making Workshop Interact Schools
summary: As part of our efforts to encourage creativity, environmental awareness and cultural values among students, Ganpati-making workshops were conducted across our Interact schools.
description:
As part of our efforts to encourage creativity, environmental awareness and cultural values among students, Ganpati-making workshops were conducted across our Interact schools.
Students enthusiastically participated in creating their own eco-friendly Ganpati idols, learning the importance of celebrating festivals in an environmentally responsible manner. The activity provided an opportunity for students to explore their artistic talents while understanding the significance of sustainable celebrations.
Schools Covered:
1. Social Service League High School
2. Maratha Mandir Babasaheb Gawde High School
3. Saraswati Mandir High School
4. Sharadashram Vidyamandir Tantrik Vidyalaya
The workshops were filled with enthusiasm, creativity and devotion, making the initiative a meaningful blend of tradition, art and environmental consciousness.
200 students participated in the workshop
Project cost – Nil
